vagas.title: Consultor SAP SD
vagas.description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


------


  • A atuação será part-time em Caxias do Sul/RS - Evetuais idas ao escritório do cliente em semanas específicas no decorrer do projeto - com os devidos reembolsos.
  • As atividades ocorrerão no período tarde/noite até 21h conforme disponibilidade do consultor.



Requisitos :

  • Dominio de SAP versão S/4 Hana, o que difere do SAP ECC, entendimento das novas funcionalidades
  • Conhecimento básico de ABAP para realizar analise de todos os Z-Objects e propor soluções já integradas ao S/4 Hana
  • Conhecimento de SAP FIORI
  • Conhecimento do conceito Clean Core
  • Conhecimento de integrações de SAP com outros sistemas
  • Experiencia em implementação de projeto, configuração e personalização de soluções conforme requisitos do negocio, modelo greenfield e brownfield
  • Conhecimento de processos de negocio


-----

Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

  • Conhecimento de SAP FIORI
  • Conhecimento do conceito Clean Core
  • Conhecimento de integrações de SAP com outros sistemas
  • Experiencia em implementação de projeto, configuração e personalização de soluções conforme requisitos do negocio, modelo greenfield e brownfield
  • Conhecimento de processos de negocio


-----

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

vagas.title: Analista de qualidade de dados
vagas.description:
Sobre a posição

Procuramos um(a) Analista de Qualidade de Dados com perfil analítico, proativo e foco na excelência, para atuar na identificação e resolução de problemas relacionados à qualidade dos dados. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de indicadores, criação e manutenção de dashboards em Power BI e análise de dados para garantir que as informações utilizadas pela organização sejam precisas, integrais e confiáveis. Valorizamos profissionais com excelente comunicação, visão sistêmica e habilidades para trabalhar em equipe, colaborando com diferentes áreas da empresa.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na análise e resolução de chamados e ocorrências relacionadas à qualidade dos dados, assegurando a consistência e integridade das informações.
  • Desenvolver, monitorar e aprimorar indicadores de qualidade de dados, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Criar, implementar e dar manutenção em dashboards interativos e relatórios utilizando Power BI.
  • Realizar extração, manipulação e análise de dados em grandes volumes, utilizando SQL e Python como principais ferramentas.
  • Contribuir com ideias para aprimorar processos de modelagem, análise e visualização de dados.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes de tecnologia e negócio para garantir a melhor utilização dos dados pela instituição.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.
  • Sólida experiência prática com SQL e Python.
  • Forte conhecimento em modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência com análise e visualização de dados, especialmente com Power BI.
  • Experiência em manipulação, tratamento e extração de dados de diferentes fontes e formatos (CSV, Excel, XML, entre outros).
  • Capacidade analítica, atenção aos detalhes e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

vagas.title: Scheduling Coordinator
vagas.description:
Together, We Change Lives — Join Our Talent Acquisition Team


We believe in connecting great people to great opportunities. Our work helps shape teams, grow careers, and support the future of technology. We’re partnering with a fast-moving, mission-driven client and are looking for an organized, detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to join their remote team.


What You’ll Do


  • Support interview scheduling, reschedules, and calendar coordination across multiple time zones.
  • Work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience.
  • Help manage offer logistics: generate and send offer letters, and track responses.
  • Assist with onboarding and documentation prep.
  • Maintain accurate data and support process consistency in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Why This Role Matters


  • You’ll help power a high-impact, fast-growing recruiting team.
  • Get exposure to a variety of teams, tools, and workflows.
  • Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and remote-friendly work culture.
  • This is a great opportunity to grow into recruiting or operations.


What We’re Looking For


  • 1–2 years of experience in recruiting coordination, HR support, or admin roles.
  • Comfort with scheduling, logistics, and using calendars/ATS tools.
  • Strong communication, time management, and organization skills.
  • Ability to work independently and thrive in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience supporting offer or onboarding processes.


Work Environment


  • Fully remote (LATAM preferred )
  • Supportive team culture with lots of learning and growth potential


Equal Opportunity Employer


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace for all applicants and team members, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, identity, orientation, age, or disability.


Diversity fuels our innovation and strengthens our team.

vagas.title: Senior Golang Engineer
vagas.description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

vagas.title: Key Account Executive
vagas.description:
Key Account Executive (Inglês Fluente)


Posição de Longo Prazo | Empresa Americana | 100% Remoto


A Blue Dot conecta talentos brasileiros a oportunidades internacionais de alto nível. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência em soluções de staffing para empresas nos Estados Unidos, buscamos profissionais ambiciosos para integrar times globais e de alta performance.

Atualmente, representamos uma empresa parceira sediada na Flórida (EUA) que busca um(a) Key Account Executive fluente em inglês, com perfil consultivo, foco em resultados e forte capacidade de relacionamento para atuar na gestão e expansão de contas B2B.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e expandir uma carteira de clientes norte-americanos, com foco em vendas consultivas B2B
  • Conduzir negociações estratégicas e fechamento de contratos com decisores (C-level)
  • Participar de reuniões e videoconferências em inglês com a liderança da empresa e com os clientes
  • Identificar as necessidades específicas de cada cliente, propondo soluções personalizadas
  • Manter registros atualizados no CRM e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos e duradouros, promovendo retenção e satisfação dos clientes


Requisitos


  • Inglês fluente (nível C1 ou C2) – toda a comunicação será realizada em inglês, inclusive o processo seletivo
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência com vendas B2B (Sales Executive, SDR, BDR, Inside Sales ou similares)
  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando (EaD aceito)
  • Comunicação clara, postura profissional e habilidade para dialogar com tomadores de decisão
  • Equipamento adequado para videoconferências e uso de CRM (preferencialmente com dois monitores)
  • Disponibilidade para utilizar traje business casual em reuniões virtuais com clientes


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com vendas internacionais ou atendimento a clientes norte-americanos
  • Familiaridade com CRMs e ferramentas de produtividade remota


Remuneração e Condições


  • Remuneração fixa: R$ 4.500,00 (regime PJ)
  • Bonificação mensal em dólares, com base em performance
  • Jornada: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 12h às 21h (1h de intervalo)
  • Posição 100% remota, com plano de carreira e oportunidades reais de crescimento.



Se você busca uma posição estável, com projeção internacional e espaço para crescimento profissional, candidate-se agora e avance para o próximo nível da sua carreira.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Solid knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Proven track record in implementation projects (greenfield or legacy modernization);
  • Experience with modern tech stacks (Java 11+, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.);
  • Good level of English, at least B2 (Mandatory);
  • Willingness to move to Portugal (Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you at

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot and microservices architecture;
  • Solid knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Proven track record in implementation projects (greenfield or legacy modernization);
  • Experience with modern tech stacks (Java 11+, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.);
  • Good level of English, at least B2 (Mandatory);
  • Willingness to move to Portugal (Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you at


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for one year period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

vagas.title: [Fully Remote] Full-stack Product Software Engineer (React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, MongoDB)
vagas.description:
Product Software Engineer


Join Oleve as a contract Full-Stack Product Engineer and help us ship features across multiple AI-powered products. You'll work directly with our product team, jumping between projects and contributing to both our existing products like Quizard and Unstuck and new 0-to-1 products we're building from the ground up.


From building responsive React and React native frontends to designing scalable Python backends to integrating AI-powered features, you'll be instrumental in delivering the product experiences that our users love as we scale from thousands to millions of users.


What you'll do:

  • Develop features across 3+ products simultaneously
  • Build responsive frontend interfaces using React and React Native
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
  • Integrate AI/ML features into product experiences
  • Collaborate closely with our full-time product engineer
  • Write clean, maintainable code that scales with our growth
  • Debug and resolve issues across the full stack


What we're looking for:

  • Proficiency in Python, FastAPI and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proficiency in React, React Native, and modern frontend development
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, database design and optimization
  • Strong experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, and agentic framewrks
  • AWS or cloud platform experience
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across time zones


Contract Details:

  • Remote work (Brazil/Latin America preferred)
  • Competitive contract rates
  • Hours must overlap with US Eastern time work hours

vagas.title: Senior SAP Developer - Ariba Technical Assessment & Clean Core Compliance
vagas.description:
A Senior SAP Developer is required to conduct a comprehensive technical assessment of an existing SAP Ariba implementation , with a focus on identifying non-compliant configurations , technical debt , and deviations from SAP best practices . The role is critical in evaluating the current build and providing a detailed analysis of areas requiring remediation or potential rebuild.

Participation in remediation or rebuild planning and execution.


Responsibilities:

Review

  • Analyze the current SAP Ariba configuration and custom developments
  • Identify hard-coded logic, non-standard extensions, and unsupported customizations
  • Evaluate the use of SAP APIs, integration methods, and extensibility frameworks

Best Practices and Gap analysis, Clean Core Compliance and Impact evaluation

  • Assess alignment with SAP clean core principles and extensibility guidelines
  • Identify functional and technical gaps impacting business operations
  • Evaluate the scalability, upgradeability, and performance of the current solution
  • Document deviations from SAP-recommended architecture and design patterns
  • Highlight risks associated with technical debt and long-term maintainability
  • Provide recommendations and High level estimation on effort required for remediation, refactoring, or potential rebuild.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with architects and process owners to understand pain points
  • Translate technical findings into business-relevant impacts and priorities

Documentation & Reporting

  • Deliver a comprehensive assessment report detailing findings, risks, and recommendations.


Skills:

  • Advanced or fluent English
  • Experience in SAP development and SAP Ariba (Buying, Sourcing, SLP and Business Network)
  • Deep understanding of SAP Ariba architecture, integration (CIG, APIs), and extensibility
  • Experience in code review, technical audits, and clean core assessments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP S/4HANA
  • Experience with common / known integration issues within Ariba, SAP and Fieldglass and its recommended solution
  • Familiarity with punch out catalog and its implementation for Brazil
  • Familiarity with MDG
  • Experience with SAP Fieldglass and S/4HANA procurement modules
  • Experience in Agile methodology usage would be differential
  • SAP certifications would be considered differential


Additional information:

  • Contract: PJ
  • Remote work

vagas.title: Especialista em IA Generativa
vagas.description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar modelos de Inteligência Artificial com foco em soluções práticas e escaláveis;
  • Atuar com Google Cloud Platform (GCP), utilizando seus serviços para orquestração, deploy e escalabilidade de modelos;
  • Programar em Python, aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e automação;
  • Integrar e consumir APIs de IA como OpenAI, Microsoft Azure AI e Vertex AI Agent Builder, para desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa;
  • Aplicar técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP) e IA Generativa em diferentes contextos de negócio;
  • Realizar a integração de soluções de IA com sistemas e produtos já existentes na empresa;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e de negócio, propondo soluções que aliem inovação e viabilidade técnica;
  • Acompanhar as tendências e inovações em IA e tecnologia, mantendo-se atualizado e contribuindo com insights para o time;
  • Garantir a qualidade, robustez e manutenibilidade do código, seguindo as melhores práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Projetar e implementar agentes inteligentes (Intelligent Agents) para diferentes finalidades e interações com usuários.


Requisitos e qualificações

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em múltiplas linguagens de programação, com foco em aplicações de IA (ex: Python, JavaScript, etc.);
  • Experiência com APIs de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente OpenAI, Microsoft Azure AI e demais provedores de mercado;
  • Domínio de técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), com aplicação prática em projetos reais;
  • Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas de MLOps para operacionalização, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção.

  • Acompanhar as tendências e inovações em IA e tecnologia, mantendo-se atualizado e contribuindo com insights para o time;
  • Garantir a qualidade, robustez e manutenibilidade do código, seguindo as melhores práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Projetar e implementar agentes inteligentes (Intelligent Agents) para diferentes finalidades e interações com usuários.


Requisitos e qualificações

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em múltiplas linguagens de programação, com foco em aplicações de IA (ex: Python, JavaScript, etc.);
  • Experiência com APIs de Inteligência Artificial, especialmente OpenAI, Microsoft Azure AI e demais provedores de mercado;
  • Domínio de técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), com aplicação prática em projetos reais;
  • Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas de MLOps para operacionalização, monitoramento e manutenção de modelos em produção.

vagas.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
vagas.description:
About Us:

Bequest.com is a Silicon Valley backed legal-tech company. We build software for trust and estate lawyers, accountants, and professional fiduciaries.


What We're Looking For:

We are looking for a Full-Stack engineer who is extremely experienced in Typescript, ambitious and hardworking. Bequest will continue to grow rapidly and we want our core members to grow with us. This is a startup, the asymmetric risk here should be attractive to you.


You will thrive at Bequest if you can own problems end-to-end, and are willing to pick up knowledge you're missing to get the job done. You will build and learn at a very fast pace with a small but mighty team. If you're ready to take on new challenges and make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you!


Compensation:

Starting salary is 80k USD/year, starting equity is 0.25%.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Frontend: Design and build complex web apps using React, design libraries (like Chakra UI) and state management tools (like Redux or Context)
  • Backend: Use Typescript, Node and NestJS/Express to build a REST API
  • Database: Design database schemas using Prisma and PostgresQL


Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in English
  • Deep understanding of Typescript (We use it everywhere!)
  • 3+ years designing and developing Frontend applications using React
  • 3+ years developing Backend APIs using NodeJS (We use NestJS)
  • Experience using SQL databases and designing schemas
  • Familiarity with Docker
  • Built production-grade apps with a high bar of quality
  • Strong problem solving skills, high agency and resourceful


Nice to Have:

  • Love Hackathons!
  • Have been an engineer at early-stage company

vagas.title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
vagas.description:
Recognized as the leading software development company in the Americas, our client offers 100% remote modality and an excellent work environment where employees can thrive, and work in multicultural teams, with flexible schedules and endless growth opportunities.


About the Role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.


What You’ll Do:


- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.


You Must Have:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:


- 100% remote work.

- Flexible hours - make your own schedule!

- Diverse and multicultural work environment.

- Paid parental leave, vacation & holidays.

- Hardware setup for you to work from home.

- Excellent compensation — well above the market average.

- Extensive opportunities for growth and professional development thanks to our mentoring system.


Enjoy the opportunity to have a dynamic lifestyle, better health, and wellness. Find renewed passion in your job, improve your productivity, and benefit from attractive growth opportunities for your career.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

vagas.title: Recruitment Assistant
vagas.description:
Na Blue Dot, localizada em São Paulo, somos uma empresa de Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) especializada em oferecer soluções perfeitas de staffing para empresas dos Estados Unidos, oferecendo os mais qualificados profissionais para nossos clientes. com uma história de mais de 10 anos, ajudamos dezenas de clientes a suprir suas demandas, bem como milhares de profissionais brasileiros a se destacar, alavancando suas carreiras em grandes players nos Estados unidos.



Responsabilidades: o que você fará?


  • Atuar como Assistant Recruiter, realizando as seguintes tarefas gerais, entre outras:

vagas.title: Senior Frontend Developer - Design System
vagas.description:
O que esperamos de você:


Você será a principal referência técnica de frontend na frente de Design System , colaborando com pessoas desenvolvedoras, designers e stakeholders de produto e negócio.


Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Atue com autonomia, visão sistêmica e capacidade de abstração para estruturar problemas e orientar o time nas soluções;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source, sendo referência dentro e fora do time.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir a evolução do nosso Design System multi-marcas , garantindo consistência visual, técnica e de acessibilidade entre os produtos;
  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas como: migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads;
  • Ser protagonista na melhoria contínua da developer experience no repositório e incentivar o uso e contribuição por toda a companhia.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento sólido em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência prática com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Liberdade técnica para propor e conduzir melhorias estruturais;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

vagas.title: Full Stack Engineer | NodeJS/ReactJS
vagas.description:
About Us

Smarter Contact is a fast-growing SaaS with a text and voice messaging communications platform enhanced with AI technologies, serving real estate professionals in the US market. We're the real estate market leader, and we're always looking for performance-driven team members to join our growing team.


We are a fast-paced, Agile environment, ideal for people who thrive in motion, not maintenance. We’re looking for highly collaborative candidates energized by building, scaling, and continuously improving.


About the role:

As we are growing our market presence we are looking for a Full stack Engineer to take ownership of the end-to-end development process, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.


If you’ve worked in slow-moving teams or highly-structured corporate settings, this pace might feel intense. But if you’re someone who tackles dynamic challenges, takes ownership fast, and learns from users - you’ll find your place here.


The people who do really well in this role are the ones who love understanding the “why” behind what they’re building. They don’t just write code, but they also heavily focus on how a feature ties into the user journey, how it impacts performance, and what happens next once it’s live. They don’t wait to be told what to do - so proactiveness is highly desired.


Ideal environment for those who love to ask questions, spot gaps, and bring ideas to the table.


Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of proven experience as a Senior Dev within a SaaS or technology-driven company.
  • Strong background in software development, architecture, and technology strategy.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and scaling technology teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies, with a focus on SaaS and cloud-based solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Technical Requirements:

  • Proficient in NodeJS for server-side development.
  • Extensive experience in building user interfaces with ReactJS and Typescript
  • Strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including but not limited to Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, and Cloud SQL.
  • In-depth knowledge of Postgres database management, including database design, optimization, and maintenance.
  • Preferred background with C# or Onion Architecture
  • Proven experience implementing and applying DDD principles and CQRS patterns in the development of scalable and maintainable systems.
  • Architectural proficiency in designing and implementing scalable, distributed systems.
  • Ability to define and implement microservices architectures for complex applications.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments, with a deep understanding of Agile methodologies and practices.


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in the messaging space
  • Worked for a fast moving startup


We are looking for the BEST that want to be part of a fast growing company that is set to take off. If you meet ALL of the qualifications, we can't wait to hear from you!

vagas.description:
About Atos


Atos is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 78,000 employees and annual revenue of c. € 10 billion. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high-performance computing, the Group provides tailored end-to-end solutions for all industries in 68 countries. A pioneer in decarbonization services and products, Atos is committed to a secure and decarbonized digital for its clients. Atos is a SE (Societas Europaea) and listed on Euronext Paris.


The purpose of Atos is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.


Senior SAP MM Functional Consultant


Work Location: Remote with occasional visits to the client's office (Rio de Janeiro).


We are looking for a SAP MM Functional Consultant to join our team. If you have solid experience and are committed to results, this could be the opportunity you have been waiting for!


Requirements:

  • Experience in the SAP MM Module, with knowledge of integrations with FI/SD modules, preferably.
  • Proven experience in functional consulting in the MM module.
  • Advanced/Fluent English for communication with the global SAP team and the ability to write functional/technical documentation in English.
  • Degree in technology courses.
  • Certification in MM Academy will be considered a differential.
  • Proactive and committed.


Benefits Offered:

  • Health Insurance

vagas.title: Sr Software Engineer
vagas.description:
ABOUT US

Syniti is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth.

Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage.

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.

As an innovative, global leader in Enterprise Data Management, the combination of our award-winning software platform and premier consultants creates a unique advantage for leading enterprises. Syniti is also a preferred data solution used by the world’s top system integrators. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts with offices in 25 countries around the world, Syniti operates in all global regions and industry verticals, and maintains a 100% client success rate across thousands of complex data projects and initiatives.


The ROLE

The Senior Software Engineer assumes a leadership role in our technical endeavors, significantly shaping the architecture, design, and implementation of our systems. Apart from mastering our tech stack, they take pride in mentoring fellow engineers and proactively identifying areas of technical improvement, breaking down complex challenges into actionable tasks.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Lead technical projects, contributing to architecture, design, and system implementation.
  • Address and reduce technical debt proactively.
  • Mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
  • Break down and delegate complex problems for team execution.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in full-stack software development.
  • Advanced full-stack skills including Go or C#, AWS, React, and Typescript/JS.
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL, NoSQL, or graph databases.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD and DevOps techniques and best practices.
  • Proficient in writing secure, production-ready code with a deep domain understanding.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and think strategically.
  • Operate with minimal supervision and be proactive in task leadership.
  • Significant impact on product quality and design simplification.
  • Be fully aligned to the our core values:

o Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

o Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

o Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

o Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are good at what you’re doing. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Hierarchies are not our thing and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen and ideas valued.


Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

vagas.title: WFH Opportunity (Personalized Internet Assessor)
vagas.description:
Looking for a freelance opportunity where you can make an impact on technology from the comfort of your home? If you are dynamic, tech-savvy, and always online to learn more, this part-time, flexible project is the perfect fit for you!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Assessor:

  • In this role, you’ll be analyzing and providing feedback on texts, pages, images, and other types of information for top search engines, using an online tool
  • Through reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you’ll be helping to improve the overall user experience for millions of search engine users, including yourself.


Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading search engines.


The estimated hourly earnings for this role are 5.00 USD per hour. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path


No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese
  • Being a resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher), and a personal computer to work on.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

vagas.title: Analista de Growth Marketing PL
vagas.description:
Somos uma HRtech, e nossa missão é tornar relações trabalhistas mais simples, eﬁcientes e justas

Como Analista de Growth Marketing Pleno  sua missão será impulsionar nossas estratégias de aquisição, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento e a escalabilidade da Nexti.

  • Será responsável por apoiar a construção e execução de iniciativas de growth com foco principal em aquisição de novos clientes, atuando de forma estratégica e orientada a dados.
  • Fará parte da expansão das nossas frentes de aquisição para produtos B2B2C, ajudando a estruturar processos, canais e campanhas voltadas a esse novo público — sem perder o foco na operação já consolidada para B2B.


Se você tem perfil analítico, visão estratégica de negócios, domina ferramentas e táticas de marketing digital e automação, e gosta de atuar com foco em resultados, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em growth marketing, com foco em aquisição, preferencialmente em empresas SaaS, HR Techs ou B2B/B2B2C.
  • Experiência em gestão de campanhas pagas de mídia digital.
  • Domínio de CRM e ferramentas de automação de marketing (RD Station, Pipedrive, Make ou similares).
  • Noções de segmentação, tracking e análise de dados de campanhas.
  • Experiência com criação de fluxos omnichannel, integrações no-code e automações.
  • Capacidade analítica, com cultura orientada a dados e tomada de decisão baseada em métricas.
  • Noções de ferramentas de analytics e dashboards.
  • Excel avançado ou Google Sheets (com fórmulas complexas, segmentações, cruzamentos de dados).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em aquisição B2B2C e estruturação de estratégias para esse público.
  • Vivência com estratégias e ferramentas de ABM.
  • Experiência prévia em contextos de Revenue Ops.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Benefícios:

️ VA/VR Nexti Flex no valor de R$ 880,00 (mensais fixos);

‍⚕️Plano de saúde Unimed;

vagas.description:

vagas.title: Remote Mathematics Specialist (PhD) - 34877
vagas.description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

  • In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and english comprehension skills
  • The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in mathematics, particularly at the level expected in engineering entrance exams, as well as graduate or PhD-level programs.
  • You should be able to break down complex mathematical concepts into simple, clear explanations and work efficiently.
  • The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Design and solve challenging math problems to probe the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop high-quality, step-by-step solutions with clear and rigorous reasoning.
  • Collaborate with LLM researchers to align problem types with evaluation goals, particularly in areas where models commonly struggle (e.g., abstraction, multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation).
  • Contribute to defining new evaluation benchmarks based on Mathematics curricula spanning early undergraduate to PhD-level topics.


Requirements:

  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent structured communication and collaboration skills in a remote setting.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Candidates pursuing a Ph.D./Postdoctoral degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field are eligible and encouraged to apply.
  • Ability to analyze and solve complex math problems with a structured and logical approach.
  • Ability to explain math concepts clearly using simple language, visuals, and examples.



Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.



Evaluation Process (approximately 80-90 mins) :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated analytical challenge (approximately 30 mins)
  • Once you clear the challenge, you will be redirected to a Mathematics assessment (approximately 30 minutes) followed by a language proficiency assessment (approximately 20 minutes).
  • Once you clear these online assessments, you are ready to go!



Offer Details:

  • The contract duration will range from a minimum of one week up to a maximum of three months.
  • Maximum of 30 hours/week is allowed
  • This contract may require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles. To be confirmed closer to the onboarding date


This is a freelance/contractor position that is paid on a per-hour basis. You also must be authorized to work in the United States, and we will not be providing visa sponsorship since this is a 1099 contract opportunity. However, if you are an international student, you may be able to sign up if you are on a visa. You should contact your tax/immigration advisor with specific questions regarding your circumstances. We are unable to provide any documentation supporting employment at this time.

vagas.title: Consultor SAP FI-CA
vagas.description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


------


Irá atuar em projetos de dunning e estratégias de cobrança.

Sap ECC


Requisitos :

  • Experiência com funcionalidades SAP ISU/CCS no módulo de FICA
  • Arquitetura de solução
  • Processo geral de arrecadação, crédito e cobrança, contábil
  • Integração com os módulos de DM, BILL, BW.
  • Atuação em Utilities – Energia e Gás


-----

Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

vagas.title: Analista Junior de Testes
vagas.description:
Como será seu a dia a dia:


  • Contribuir com as evoluções na forma de trabalho, buscando abrdagens modernas para garantir a qualidade de nossos produtos buscando evolução constante;
  • Atuar na execução de testes manuais e automatizados, validações junto aos clientes para os módulos e serviços que compõem o ecossistema da nossa solução. Estar sempre atento aos desafios da função e problemas de execução e performance em geral. E buscando assegurar a continuidade das operações e a melhor experiência para o usuário;
  • Analisar os resultados dos testes manuais e automatizados;
  • Relatar bugs e melhorias para as equipes de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir a qualidade dos nossos produtos durante todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software;
  • Desenvolver planos de testes, casos de testes funcionais/não funcionais e executar testes manuais e automatizados;
  • Atuar desde as fases iniciais de levantamento de requisitos, ajudando a descrever os critérios de aceite e acompanhar os testes de aceitação/homologação junto ao cliente;
  • Possuir capacidade de priorizar o seu próprio trabalho a partir das linhas gerais definidas pelo time e de feedbacks recebidos dos principais stakeholders.


O que esperamos de você:


  • Graduação completa na área de tecnologia
  • Inglês intermediário para compreensão e leitura
  • Bons conhecimentos e certa experiência comprovada como testador de software, engenheiro de testes de software ou função semelhante;
  • Conhecimentos em alguma das seguintes ferramentas: Selenium Webdriver, SoapUI/Postman, JUnit/NUnit, JMeter;
  • Conhecimentos na técnica de desenvolvimento ágil BDD (Behavior Driven Development).


A posição é remota, poré, caso resida na cidade de São Paulo e estiver há 24km do escritório da Unisys (Ponte João Dias), será presencial 3 vezes na semana.

vagas.title: Desenvolvedor Backend
vagas.description:
Sobre a Irricontrol


A Irricontrol é uma empresa com a missão de revolucionar a agricultura de precisão com inovações tecnológicas na área de irrigação a nível nacional e internacional. Estamos desenvolvendo soluções digitais para agricultura capazes de transformar a atividade agrícola cada vez mais sustentável e produtiva.


Se você se sente motivado por ver seu trabalho sendo traduzido em ferramentas e produtos que geram valor ao produtor rural, a Irricontrol pode te oferecer essa jornada. Somos motivados pela missão de levar a tecnologia brasileira para mais de 32 países através do Grupo Bauer e acreditamos que a informalidade e o profissionalismo andam juntos. Por isso, nos preocupamos que todos na Irricontrol se sintam à vontade no ambiente de trabalho.


Procuramos pessoas com espírito empreendedor, com vontade contínua de aprender e coragem para enfrentar desafios. Confira os detalhes e boa sorte:


O que você vai fazer


  • Analisar, desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações web performáticas e escaláveis;
  • Desenvolver e implantar códigos backend;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes de desenvolvimento backend e frontend durante o desenvolvimento de projetos;
  • Projetar, especificar e construir novos bancos de dados;
  • Elaborar documentações técnicas dos sistemas e suas funcionalidades;
  • Solucionar problemas de performance;
  • Elaborar, desenvolver e documentar testes unitários;
  • Automatizar processos e rotinas de trabalho.


O que esperamos que você tenha

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de backend;
  • Experiência utilizando Python;
  • Conhecimento dos frameworks Django e FastAPI;
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de criar documentação de APIs.


O que oferecemos

Contratação CLT;

Atuação 100% remota;

Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

Wellhub (antigo GymPass);

Vale Alimentação flexível;

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (para você e dependentes) com cobertura nacional e sem coparticipação.


Se identifica com nosso propósito?

Sua inscrição não levará mais que 5min. Clique e candidate-se!

vagas.title: Full Stack Developer (AI Automation)
vagas.description:
About Us

Workstreet delivers AI-driven vCISO services that build and run security and compliance programs aligned with SOC 2, ISO 42001, ISO 27001, and other frameworks. We offer over 100 services in our catalog to the fastest-growing technology companies worldwide.


The Role

We’re hiring our first AI Automation Engineer to turn manual services into agent-driven workflows. All signals, no slide decks.


Responsibilities

  • Pair with the CTO to mine pain points, rank ROI, and define success metrics.
  • Ship AI-first utilities or embed them into our existing products; measure impact.
  • Debug front-end, back-end, and infra when agents misbehave.
  • Safeguard sensitive data; zero tolerance for security regressions.
  • Track and test bleeding-edge models, frameworks, and agent designs.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Full-stack mastery (JavaScript and Python minimum).
  • Extensive experience building and shipping SaaS products.
  • Production experience with AI/ML systems, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration.
  • Rapid prototyping reflex; features in hours, not days.
  • Strong systems-level debugging chops.
  • Previous automation work that delivered measurable business value.
  • Security mindset for handling sensitive data.
  • Self-directed and relentless on the AI learning curve.

Why Work at Workstreet

  • Hyper-growth: 0 to 350 paying clients in 17 months.
  • Bootstrapped & profitable: revenue covers all R&D; no VC, no runway drama.
  • Build the future of vCISO: every commit wipes hours of manual analyst work.
  • Work from anywhere: remote-first; ship code from wherever, results rule.

Requirements

  • US Eastern-time overlap.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Portfolio or links to shipped AI and automation projects/products.

vagas.title: Digital Verification - Remoto
vagas.description:
HCLTech Brazil is hiring Digital Verification (DV) Engineers to develop SoCs and IPs in conjunction with one of the largest semiconductor companies, based on North America and leader in the automotive, power management and IoT segments ! Come to be part of this challenge with us!



Requirements and Activities:



The candidates must have 5+ years of experience and the expectations for the role are the following:​



  • Advanced English


  • Versed in SystemVerilog, C, Assembly and OOP-based languages (SV-UVM)​


  • Experience in creating verification plans based on design specification​


  • Experience in test case development, simulation and debugging with standard tools (Xcelium, VCS or QuestaSim)​


  • Experience with code coverage analysis (functional coverage is a plus)​


  • Basic knowledge in SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)​


  • Desirable experience in test bench development (drivers, monitors, agents, scoreboards, etc)​


  • Experience with serial protocols like SPI, I2C, USB, UART, USART, CAN, Ethernet or others​


  • Familiar with architecture of ARM Cortex processors (RISCV is a plus)​


  • Ability to develop scripts for verification automation (shell, tcl, perl, python, etc)​


  • Basic knowledge about version control systems (Git, DesignSync, Perforce, Subversion, Clearcase, etc)​


  • Experience in gate-level simulations is a plus​


  • Basic knowledge about Formal verification is a plus​


  • Background in verification of MIPI standard interfaces is a plus​


  • Background in verification of Video Encoder and Decoder is a plus.​



HCLTech is a worldwide company, present in more than 60 countries and is a well recognized partner to over 50% of the Global 500 companies. HCLTech is a Top Employer in 28 countries, and is present in Brazil for more than 15 years. The HCLTech division of Engineering and R&D Services is partnering with our customers to enable technologies and innovation in different state-of-art applications.​


HCLTech Semiconductor Design Center in Brazil is engaged with multiple worldwide partners, helping our customers in different areas of Semiconductor Engineering, including Architecture, Design, Verification, Physical Design, DFT, Analog and Custom Layout, and Post-Si validation. The Brazil Semiconductor Design Center has more than 26 years of experience in developing microcontrollers and designing highly complex IPs (Digital and Analog) for different applications, in different technology nodes.​

vagas.title: DevOps Specialist
vagas.description:
Perfil Profissional:

▪ O profissional DevOps é responsável por construir e manter os jobs de build, integração contínua e entrega contínua das aplicações, programar scripts para containers, programar automações em Ansible ou outras tecnologias similares, além de viabilizar a integração com outras ferramentas (JIRA, SAST, DAST, Sonarqube, Git, Nexus, etc).

▪ O profissional DevOps deve promover, junto com a Equipe de Apoio Especializado ou de Sustentação, melhorias nos processos de DevOps e a transição de repositórios obsoletos para o pipeline de automação.


Experiência/Qualificação :

- Sólida experiência em atividades de engenharia de software com linguagens JAVA e JAVASCRIPT e como DevOps ou cargo correlato.

- Possuir certificação DevOps Essentials Professional Certificate - DEPC® ou Exin DevOps Foundation ou equivalente.

- Possuir experiência e conhecimentos nas seguintes tecnologias e processos:

▪ Controle de releases, versionamento com GitLab/Github e outras práticas ligadas a CI/CD

▪ Criação e manutenção DevOps com CI/CD automatizado

▪ Ambiente Openshift, Docker ou Kubernetes (avaliar certificações RH necessárias)

▪ Ambiente com API Manager/API Gateway

vagas.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Java + NoSQL + AWS)
vagas.description:
Full-Stack Engineer (Java + NoSQL + AWS) – Remote Brazil

Location: Remote (Brazil)


Job Description:

We are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus and hands-on experience in Java and NoSQL databases . The ideal candidate will contribute to building scalable, high-performance microservices and event-driven applications in a cloud-native environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems using Java (Vert.x framework is a plus).
  • Collaborate on full-stack development using JavaScript frameworks (React or Angular), HTML/CSS , and UI/UX best practices.
  • Build and optimize microservices , event-driven architectures , and APIs (GraphQL and REST).
  • Work with NodeJS , Golang , and gRPC (preferred but not mandatory).
  • Manage data storage using SQL and NoSQL databases , including DynamoDB , Elasticsearch , and Postgres Aurora .
  • Leverage AWS cloud services (Compute, API Gateway, VPC, Kubernetes, Fargate/EKS) and containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and integrate tools such as Kafka/MKS .
  • Monitor and maintain operational excellence using Prometheus , CloudWatch , Kibana , and PagerDuty .

vagas.title: Talent Acquisition
vagas.description:
At Blueground , our vision is to make people feel at home wherever they choose to live. For us, that means ensuring our guests have the peace of mind, flexibility & confidence they need to explore life’s latest adventure.


We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team and help us attract and develop top talent across USA. You will focus on bringing on-board amazing people that will love our culture and embrace our values. If you are a target-driven professional, who has a passion for attracting great talent and creating an exceptional candidate experience, this is an opportunity to drive your career forward! As a Blueground talent scout, you will manage the recruitment process from end to end and collaborate with our leadership team to bring on board amazing people.

What you will focus on:

  • Sourcing - be an expert in sourcing hard-to-fill positions and finding the best talent in PropTech through using innovative sourcing methods including utilizing an agile sourcing methodology across USA
  • Proactive Talent Pooling - build diverse talent pools through effective targeting and talent pipelining of both passive and active candidates. You will be responsible for actively overseeing regular and accurate updates of our global job adverts, external jobs boards, recruitment networking and the promotion of our refer a friend scheme; keeping D&I in mind through every part of the Talent Attraction process.
  • Be a Blueground Ambassador - Get people excited about Blueground and match great talent to great opportunities. You will often be the first person that someone talks to from Blueground, so you need to be great at understanding what motivates them and match their motivations with the many benefits of working here.
  • Collaborative Hiring Process - Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and relevant stakeholders, ensuring a seamless interview process for candidates. Facilitate candidate feedback sessions and debrief meetings to gather input and make informed hiring decisions. Work closely with HR teams to manage offer negotiations, pre-employment checks, and onboarding processes.
  • Candidate Relationship Management - Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely communication and guidance. Ensure a positive candidate experience by delivering clear and transparent communication, managing expectations, and providing feedback. Build and maintain relationships with candidates to create a pipeline of talent for current and future hiring needs.

What we are looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience with hiring process;
  • Knowledge and experience of online sourcing including social/professional networking (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter).
  • Candidate experience focused, passionate about employer branding and being creative in our approach to sourcing talent.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, tenacious, personable and articulate.
  • Advanced English
  • Ability to establish trusted relationships with management, candidates and external partners.
  • Positive attitude combined with a desire to make work fun.
  • A team player that will fit with our values and add to our culture.

vagas.title: Recruiter Brazil
vagas.description:
Job Title: Recruiter Brazil

Location: (LATAM,Hybrid or Remote)

Employment Type: (CLT)

About the Role

The purpose of this position is to start with someone supporting our daily activities, as formatting cvs, matching ideally candidates with the vacancies opened by the client and this professional will also be scheduling interviews for candidates with the clients. The idea is that in the future, this person will develop skills of sourcing, screening and interviewing candidates. As well as reporting daily activities with the TA Manager, tracking the key recruitment metrics and providing data driven insights to improve our hiring process.

Responsibilities

• Source candidates using job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals

• Conduct initial screenings to assess qualifications, experience, and cultural fit

• Coordinate and schedule interviews, acting as the liaison between candidates and hiring managers

• Collaborate with account managers and sales teams to understand job requirements and define recruitment strategies

• Promote employer branding through recruitment campaigns that highlight company values, culture, and benefits

• Ensure compliance with legal regulations and internal hiring policies

• Maintain accurate candidate records in the ATS and report on recruitment metrics

• Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future openings

• Qualify or reject candidates based on resume reviews and interview feedback

• Serve as the main point of contact for candidate inquiries

• Meet weekly activity quotas related to outreach (calls and emails)

Requirements

• Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Familiarity with ATS platforms and sourcing tools

• Ability to manage multiple requisitions and priorities simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience recruiting in the HR services or staffing industry

• Knowledge of outbound recruitment strategies and tools like LinkedIn,

• Strong knowledge in Englis is needed.

Who We Are

Talent where you need it, when you need it!

SGF Global is a leading specialized talent solutions provider dedicated to connecting highly qualified professionals with opportunities across multiple sectors. We offer contract, temporary, and permanent hiring solutions for roles in technology, finance and accounting, engineering, marketing and creative, legal services, administrative and customer support, energy, oil and gas, telecommunications, manufacturing, aerospace, life sciences, mining, and utilities.

At SGF Global, we work to put you in the best position to succeed. We provide access to top-tier positions, competitive compensation, attractive benefits, and free online training.

vagas.title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno
vagas.description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno na Sankhya , você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.

Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de produto e qualidade;
  • Escrever código limpo, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua e ganhos de performance;
  • Apoiar na definição de estimativas de esforço, contribuindo para o planejamento e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Participar ativamente dos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas);
  • Colaborar com a documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades ou alterações realizadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimentos e boas práticas com pares, apoiando o fortalecimento técnico coletivo do time.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência como Dev Pleno (sistemas de média ou alta complexidade);
  • Java (orientação a objetos) como principal linguagem de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de front-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com SQL Server (consultas, tuning, estrutura relacional);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código via GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e práticas de design patterns;
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e automação de testes;


Localidade | Atuação

Uberlândia/MG: Presencial

São Paulo/SP: Híbrido (2vz na semana no escritório)

Demais localidades: Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação CLT


Informações adicionais


Benefícios que vão além da Jornada Sankher


Na Sankhya, valorizamos a individualidade e acreditamos em proporcionar benefícios que vão além do básico, promovendo a liberdade e o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Nosso objetivo é oferecer todo o apoio necessário para que você se sinta bem e satisfeito em todas as áreas da sua vida.

vagas.title: Presales Manager (team of x4 SE's)
vagas.description:
Sales Engineer Manager/ Manager of the Sales Engineer Team/ Pre-Sales Manager – LATAM (Remote)

  • Managing a team of x4 Sales Engineers/Pre-Sales across LATAM
  • Cybersecurity experience required


Amberes has partnered with a leading PE-backed, Cyber and Back Up Business in search of a new/ growth hire - Sales Engineering Manager to lead a team across Latin America. As the Manager of the team, you’ll drive technical pre-sales efforts, support deal execution, and manage a team aligned with regional sales goals. This role combines leadership and direct involvement in strategic opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and coach a regional Sales Engineering team, ensuring strong technical execution.
  • Align team output with sales goals; oversee training, performance, and workload balancing.
  • Support key deals as a senior technical expert, shaping proposals and guiding customers.
  • Ensure high-quality responses to RFPs/RFIs and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with sales and product teams to share market feedback and drive improvement.
  • Track and report on pre-sales activities; identify areas to improve win rates.


Requirements:

  • Fluent in English
  • At least 5+ years in the IT industry, including 3+ years in pre-sales or solutions engineering.
  • At least 3+ years in a technical leadership role managing Sales Engineers, Solution Consultants or Technical Account Managers
  • Strong understanding of any form of cybersecurity , or backup, disaster recovery, and storage solutions.
  • Solid knowledge of virtualisation (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).


If of interest, please apply!


Thank you,

Team Amberes

vagas.title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - 100% Remoto
vagas.description:
Qual o tamanho dos seus objetivos? Deseja novos desafios?


Então, vem para TQI!


A TQI é uma empresa de tecnologia e inovação que há mais de 30 anos, desenvolve soluções para suportar e alavancar os negócios de seus clientes no Brasil e no exterior.

Com escritórios em Uberlândia (MG) e em São Paulo (SP), e colaboradores em centenas de cidades, a TQI conquistou e mantém há mais de 6 anos o selo Great Place to Work (GPTW), e está no ranking 80+ do GPTW de Tecnologia, reforçando seu compromisso para promover um ambiente diverso e propício para inovação e alta performance.



Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Modelo de contrato: PJ


O que procuramos:


  • Conhecimento avançado em Python;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em SQL (tuning de queries e análise de dados);
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência com GitHub;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform;
  • Experiência em AWS Redshift e AWS S3;
  • Conhecimento em segurança de dados;
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta criticidade e volumetria;
  • Conhecimento em Jenkins, Kafka e Apache Airflow;
  • Experiência com levantamento de requisitos;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Big Data;
  • Conhecimento em construção e otimização de ETL;
  • Conhecimento processo de CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em observability e leitura/interpretação de logs;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Experiência com orquestração de containers (ECS, Kubernetes e Docker);
  • Conhecimento em Data Quality.


Desejável:


  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de rede (TCP/IP, VPC etc.) para atuar em cenários de troca com o time de redes e firewall;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines batch e near real time;
  • Experiência com AWS (Route53, ECS, SQS, STS, API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, AWS cross-account/region, VPC, CloudFront, SSM, WAF, GuardInspector e CloudWatch).


Principais atividades:


  • Subir, redimensionar a capacidade e configurar regras de cluster AWS Redshif, gerenciando as configurações do ambiente;
  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção de scripts Python e Terraform para infraestrutura;
  • Desenvolver soluções com grandes volumes de dados;
  • Garantir políticas de segurança para acesso aos dados;
  • Fomentar a utilização de técnicas de automação para criação, configuração e monitoramento dos ambientes analíticos.


O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.


Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!


O time está te esperando, vamos nessa?
